What needs my attention in this packet?.question: What needs my attention in this packet?

statements.text: All five automated rule checks passed, and the packet's overall status is ready for review. No rule failures need your attention.
Construction is not the same at every location. L2 in Dayton is joisted masonry, while L1 and L3 are masonry noncombustible.
The application gives a year built only for the main building. The other locations have no year built in the packet.
The loss runs show one closed claim in five years: a 2024 burst pipe water damage loss paid at $12,300.
The loss runs are valued as of 09/30/2026, so the last three months of the 2026 policy year are not included.
The application and the broker email agree on sprinkler protection. The application marks it Yes, and the broker says all buildings are fully sprinklered.
The contact details differ slightly. The application lists a generic producer email, but the submission came from Dana Reyes at a different address.

What does the email say about loss runs?.question: What does the email say about loss runs?

statements.text: The broker email says five years of loss runs are attached, along with the application and the location schedule.

citations.quote: The application, location schedule and five years of loss runs are attached.

statements.text: The attached loss run report covers 5 policy years, 2022 to 2026, which matches the five years described in the email.
The loss history check passed because a readable loss runs report covering 5 years is attached.

citations.quote: R5 Loss history: PASS. A readable loss runs report is attached and covers 5 years (at least 3 required).

Where does the total insured value come.question: Where does the total insured value come from?

statements.text: The total insured value of $8,400,000 is stated in Section A of the application, and it covers all locations.
The broker's cover email gives the same figure.

citations.quote: Requested effective date: January 1, 2027. Total insured value: $8,400,000.

statements.text: The location schedule does not give a value for each location, so the total cannot be rebuilt by location from the packet. The schedule only lists address and construction.
The automated check R3 used this $8,400,000 figure and found it within the $10,000,000 authority limit.

citations.quote: R3 Total insured value within authority: PASS. Total insured value $8,400,000 is within $10,000,000.
